The generator now realizes 1–6 cardinal-neighbour survivors constructively, including adjacent multi-core objects, with exact auxiliary distractor counts. This removes the prior one-centre-per-object shortcut while retaining the byte-exact canonical rule.

The native parameter is `preprocess`:

- `merge_1_into_2` — maps input color 1 to 2, then runs the unchanged survivor filter.

The second setting is genuinely sequential: the full post-merge intermediate determines the same-color neighbourhoods consumed by the nonlinear survivor filter. The public projection produced and verified 16 independent single-query views; first-turn privacy passed 24 private-field invariance checks and 4 positive controls.

A 10,000-case exploratory boundary probe found accidental horizontal-symmetry aborts in sparse `plain` draws. After the first fix, a wider 18,000-case boundary probe exposed the analogous `on_axis` failure. Both now use permanent different-color mirrored witnesses; the final 18,000/18,000 minimum-grid exact-axis stress passed across all textures and legal mark boundaries.

The native parameter is `axis`:
